problem:
Consider the matrix $M,$ given by

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}-1 & 2 & 4 \\ 8 & 3 & 1 \\ 3 & -1 & 9\end{aligned}].
$$

What matrix results from carrying out the row operation ${R}_{3}:={R}_{3}+3{R}_{1}$ on $M?$

feedback.problem:
Consider the matrix $A,$ given by

$$
A=[\begin{aligned}0 & 8 & 1 \\ 3 & 3 & 6 \\ 4 & -1 & 3\end{aligned}].
$$

What matrix results from carrying out the row operation ${R}_{1}↔{R}_{2}$ on $A?$
feedback.worked_solution:
The operation ${R}_{1}↔{R}_{2}$ means that we need to swap the first and second rows.

Applying this row operation, we obtain the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =[\begin{aligned}0 & 8 & 1 \\ 3 & 3 & 6 \\ 4 & -1 & 3\end{aligned}] & {R}_{1}↔{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}3 & 3 & 6 \\ 0 & 8 & 1 \\ 4 & -1 & 3\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$
